title: See Barcelona Through a Different Lens!
text: We did this tour when we first moved to Barcelona, and found it so interesting. The guide was knowledgeable and passionate and brought the city to life in a very unique way. Would highly recommend.
author: Cruiser55986320866

title: Fantastic Guided Tour - Fun, Informative, Immersive!
text: I began my week in Barcelona with the Beyond Orwell & Hemingway Literary Tour with the guide, Tadhg. It was a great decision. Rather than wandering around the Old City -- Gothic Neighborhood, The Raval and The Born on my own, ignorant of all that surrounded me, I was immersed in the literary and human story behind the façades. Tadhg is fantastic, knowledgeable, passionate, and fun! The tour and the route were well thought out and you do not have to be an intellectual or academic to enjoy it. (Note: you will walk a lot!) There was a welcomed rest at a café in a bookstore with time for questions
author: glenngroves9

title: Awesome!
text: A great tour to discover the rich legacy and cultural old and récent History of Barcelona ! Loads of information and Books to read to put your holiday memories in context! A must do!!!!
author: Bernard_P

title: Solo literary tour in Barcelona
text: This tour is amazing for booklovers. It covers a large sélection of books where action takes place in Barcelona. If you are fans of The Shadow of the Wind by Zafon & The Cathedral of the sea by Falcones you will not be disapointed. The guide, Tadgh, knows his reading and knows Barcelona. Prepare for a lot of walking and for surprising discoveries. Would recommend +++
author: IULIA_P

title: Excellent tour… fascinating!!!
text: The tour guide was phenomenal.. knew extensive history about Barcelona and intertwined numerous writers with stories and historical facts … an expert on Hemingway and Orwell… we walked around the city.. Raval and Gothic Quarter… he told various stories of the writers …where they lived , what they wrote and where they wrote it…. He also spoke about important Latin American writers… I would love to take the tour again … so much fascinating history… definitely 10 out of 10!!!
author: Melissa_P

title: Different, Better
text: An interesting tour, different from those typical ones, that left me with a robust reading list. An excellent tour to actually get to know the city you are in.
author: Jonathan_P
